title: TADPOLE Six-Modality Disease-Relation Evaluation Recovery
feature_protocol: inner-train-only StandardScaler and deterministic full-solver PCA up to 32 dimensions, zero padding, absdiff/product/cosine 65 dimensions; relation-feature scaler fits T-T pairs only

p0_difference.solver: P0 did not complete. P0.1 retains lbfgs but explicitly requests the true multinomial backend. sklearn 1.3.2 newton-cholesky was rejected because it does not support multinomial.
p0_difference.caps: P0 registered caps of 4000 per six-class relation and 12000 per binary class were retained after preflight.
p0_difference.efficiency: Shared pair indices and feature matrices within each inner-fold modality, plus SQLite atomic task persistence and resume.

resume: progress.sqlite, one atomic transaction per relation-task, 10 outer x 5 inner x 6 modalities x 2 tasks = 600 tasks
